definition_quote.value: "Dietetics" means the integration and application of principles derived from the sciences of nutrition, biochemistry, food, physiology, behavioral and social sciences to provide nutrition services that include: nutrition assessment, the establishment of priorities, goals and objectives that meet nutritional needs, the provisions of nutrition counseling in health and disease, the development, implementation and management of nutrition care plans, and the evaluation and maintenance of appropriate standards of quality in food and nutrition
definition_quote.quote:
"Dietetics" means the integration and application of principles derived from the sciences of nutrition, biochemistry, food, physiology, behavioral and social sciences to provide nutrition services that include:
